sources.entry: Dreeve ⚠ - Statistics dashboard generated from Strava data. (Demo, Source Code) AGPL-3.0 Docker/K8S

summary.one_liner: Dreeve is a self-hosted, open-source dashboard for sports and fitness data, formerly known as "Statistics for Strava".
summary.what_it_does: Dreeve imports activities from raw FIT, TCX and GPX files, from services such as Garmin, Polar, Wahoo and Apple Health, or from a connected Strava account. It provides a dashboard of stats and charts, a browsable activity list, a monthly calendar view, Eddington number tracking, segment and effort history, and a heatmap of where you've been active. Gear tracking covers per-bike and per-shoe usage and maintenance wear. It also includes a milestones timeline, a "Rewind" year-in-review, Strava challenges and trophies, and an activity photo archive. Integrations include an AI workout assistant (any AI provider or a local Ollama model), an MCP server for clients like Claude and Cursor, embeddable user badges, and PWA support. An admin panel and automation rules fill in gear, commute flags and sport types.
use_cases: Self-host a dashboard for Strava activity data
Analyze cycling and running stats and charts
Track bike and shoe mileage and maintenance
Import FIT, TCX or GPX workout files
Connect an AI assistant to workout data
notable: Imports raw FIT, TCX and GPX files as well as Strava accounts
MCP server for connecting Claude, Cursor and other MCP clients
Embeddable user badges for websites and forum profiles
caveats: Listed on awesome-selfhosted with a warning marker, which the list uses for projects with notable concerns; the README itself does not explain it
The README does not include installation commands; it points to external documentation
